title: Viva Engage: My Team audiences and flexible targeting for Storyline Announcements
summary: The briefing's rollout dates, licensing statements and existing control paths are supported by Microsoft's sources. The updated storyline documentation still supports the creator restriction; the remaining targeting-specific administrative gaps are appropriately distinguished from existing controls.

claims.claim: The feature concerns Viva Engage leader communications, starting with Storyline Announcements, in Microsoft Viva.
claims.quote: We’re introducing more flexible and precise targeting capabilities in Viva Engage, starting with Storyline Announcements.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: An administrator view for saved custom audiences is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage My Team saved custom audiences admin manage delete 40 audiences activity log publish time targeting Entire organization; opened Storyline announcements in Viva Engage and The role of leaders. No administrator view for saved custom audiences was stated.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Governance controls; controls[0].note; Open questions
claims.claim: Only Engage admins, verified admins, network admins and corporate communicators can enable Entire organization for a leader.
claims.quote: Leaders and delegate managers can't enable this option. Only Engage admins, Viva Engage verified admins, Viva Engage network admins, and corporate communicators can allow leaders to reach the entire organization.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether the Entire organization restriction constrains broad custom attribute or group selections.
claims.quote: Searched: My Team Viva Engage Entire organization admin; opened Storyline announcements in Viva Engage and The role of leaders. Support retains admin enablement of Entire organization but does not say whether custom attribute/group selections are constrained by that toggle.

claims.claim: The Manage leaders activity log covers changes to leaders and their audiences over the past 30 days.
claims.quote: To track changes to leaders and their audiences over the past 30 days, use the activity log available on the Manage Leaders page.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not document publish-time audience choices as entries in the Manage leaders activity log.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage My Team saved custom audiences activity log publish time targeting; opened The role of leaders, Storyline announcements in Viva Engage and Track Viva Engage events. No statement includes publish-time selections in the Manage leaders log.

claims.claim: Leaders, leaders' delegates, delegate managers and corporate communicators can post Storyline Announcements.
claims.quote: Leaders, leaders' delegates, delegate managers, and corporate communicators can post announcements.

claims.claim: Microsoft Support says users identified as leaders with a configured audience can post announcements.
claims.quote: Users identified as leaders in Viva Engage with a configured audience can post announcements.

claims.claim: Learn requires leader identification and audience management for storyline announcements to work successfully.

claims.claim: Learn states that a leader can add up to 40 audiences.
claims.quote: A leader can add up to 40 audiences.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not state whether the 40-audience limit applies to saved audiences in the new targeting experience.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage My Team saved custom audiences admin manage delete 40 audiences activity log publish time targeting Entire organization; opened The role of leaders and Storyline announcements in Viva Engage. Neither specifies the limit's application to new saved custom audiences.

claims.claim: The notice says leaders do not need advance audience setup for the new targeting.
claims.quote: No dependency on IT or advance audience setup—leaders can act immediately when communication needs arise.

claims.claim: The audience control is reached in the Viva Engage admin center through Feature management > Leadership identification and audiences > Manage leaders > leader (pencil icon) > Manage audiences > Add new audience.
claims.quote: On the Feature management tab, select Leadership identification and audiences to go to the Manage leaders page. ... select the pencil icon ... The Manage audiences page appears ... select the Add new audience button

claims.claim: No documented API or PowerShell equivalent sets leader identification and leader audiences.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage leader audiences delegate management activity log PowerShell Microsoft Graph API manage audiences; leadership audiences storyline creators activity log REST API PowerShell reference. Opened Graph engagement API overview (beta) and Legacy Viva Engage Core APIs; no equivalent.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: The documented Manage audiences control covers pre-configured audiences, but Microsoft does not explicitly describe its governance of My Team or publish-time selections.
claims.quote: Searched: My Team Viva Engage Entire organization admin; Viva Engage My Team saved custom audiences admin manage delete. Opened The role of leaders and Storyline announcements in Viva Engage. Neither connects the admin Manage audiences control to new publish-time selections or My Team.

claims.claim: A leader reaches Delegate management through the ellipsis menu next to their profile picture in Viva Engage.
claims.quote: In the Engage Teams application, select the ellipsis (...) menu next to your profile picture in the upper-right corner ... Select Delegate management.

claims.claim: No documented API or PowerShell equivalent assigns a leader's delegates or delegate managers.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage delegate management assign delegates API PowerShell REST user delegation. Opened The role of leaders, Graph engagement API overview (beta) and Legacy Viva Engage Core APIs. Results about Viva Org Insights delegation govern another product, not Engage delegates.

claims.claim: The documented delegate configuration is performed by the leader in the Engage app in Teams.
claims.quote: Leaders follow these steps to configure delegates: ... In the Engage Teams application

claims.claim: The storyline creator control is at Viva Engage admin center > Feature management > Storyline > Advanced Settings > Edit > Specify storyline creators.
claims.quote: from the Engage admin center, go to Feature management > Storyline. ... Select Edit in Advanced Settings. ... Switch Specify storyline creators to Eligible users from selected group.

claims.claim: No documented API or PowerShell equivalent sets the storyline creator restriction.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage Specify storyline creators settings PowerShell REST API; Viva Engage leadership audiences storyline creators activity log REST API PowerShell reference. Opened Manage and set up storyline, Graph engagement API overview (beta) and Legacy Viva Engage Core APIs; no equivalent.

claims.where: controls[2].note; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: Specify storyline creators restricts who has a storyline and can create posts, rather than being a separate audience-targeting setting.
claims.quote: This setting controls who has a storyline feed on their user profile and who can create new storyline posts. It doesn’t restrict who can view, react, or reply to storyline posts made by others.

claims.claim: The leader and audience activity log is at Viva Engage admin center > Feature management > Leadership identification and audiences > Manage leaders > activity log.
claims.quote: On the Feature management tab, select Leadership identification and audiences to go to the Manage leaders page. ... use the activity log available on the Manage Leaders page.

claims.claim: No documented automation equivalent retrieves the Manage leaders activity log.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage leadership audiences storyline creators activity log REST API PowerShell reference. Opened The role of leaders, Graph engagement API overview (beta), Legacy Viva Engage Core APIs and Track Viva Engage events; none documents retrieval of the Manage leaders activity log.

claims.where: controls[4]; Why it matters; Governance controls; Open questions; rationale: risk

claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage Specify storyline creators settings PowerShell REST API My Team flexible targeting tenant disable saved audiences limit. Opened Support Storyline announcements, Learn leaders/storyline, Graph engagement API overview (beta) and Legacy Core APIs; no separate switch.

claims.claim: Leader audiences can be edited by Engage admins, verified admins, network admins, corporate communicators, leaders and their delegate managers.
claims.quote: This task is for the Engage admin, Viva Engage verified admin, Viva Engage network admin, corporate communicator, and leader or leader's delegate managers.

claims.claim: Engage administrators manage storyline settings.
